_note: Inputs of jenga-scan-plan. tower: teammate's tower_pose.yaml / tower_nominal.json (world frame, z0 = tower base). dino: Dino tip pose in the hand frame (ah?_base_link) = GUESS until measured: axis from the pick pose (Dino hangs tip-down in the jig), tip point not measured.

tower._layer_h_note: 0.02186 from the 2026-10-30 check: taught L13 shots on +x were 6 mm lower than with 0.02236 (teammate value), relative to the L01 calibration

dino._tool_note: tool_hand: Dino frame in the hand frame from jenga-calib (origin = point in focus, z = optical axis, y = image down). A missing arm uses the other one mirrored. tip_to_focus_m: Dino tip behind the focus point (measured at dial 30, only for the sim clearance).

_roll_note: roll_deg = where the hand sits around the Dino axis (per arm). Chosen by reachability 2026-10-29: right 270 covers -y and +x, left 90 covers -x and +y. The image then is rotated by a multiple of 90 deg: rotate it in software (image_rotate, to be set at the first real shot).
_jig_note: jig_y: world y of the Dino jig centre (m). 0 = robot centre line (assumed, NOT measured); left pick poses = right ones mirrored and shifted by 2*jig_y.
